decisions.reason: The finisher sits close to the core offer and has its own product page, so results that meet the aspiration in a growing industry give no trigger for search, and existing slack covers it.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core and its results are still uncertain, but as a flagship with a German premiere event it carries management commitment, and slack from a broad, growing portfolio lets the firm carry it.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established offer and complements the finishing lines, so performance is likely satisfactory and there is little reason to cut it.
This B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the core and matches the firm's automation direction, which makes it a strong candidate to meet aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the established booklet-making offer and has its own page, so nothing signals a shortfall that would prompt problemistic search.
The folding add-on shows a documented customer installation achieving one-pass processing, evidence that results meet aspiration for this low-cost extension of the core range.
